name: Casio A158
description: Classic digital watch with stainless steel bracelet and timeless retro styling.
longDescription: An iconic retro digital from Casio’s Vintage line, the A158 keeps things simple, legible, and ultra-wearable for daily use.

name: Casio AE1200 World Time
description: World time digital watch with retro style.
longDescription: The Casio AE-1200WH is perfect for travelers with its world time feature covering 48 cities. It also includes a stopwatch, countdown timer, and LED backlight, wrapped in a sleek retro-modern design.

name: Citizen Promaster Dive Eco-Drive
description: Professional ISO-rated dive watch powered by light.
longDescription: The Citizen Promaster Dive Eco-Drive BN0190-82E is a rugged ISO-certified diver designed for serious underwater use. Featuring a stainless steel bracelet, luminous hands and markers, and a unidirectional rotating bezel, it delivers reliability and legibility in demanding conditions. Powered by Eco-Drive technology, it never requires a battery change.

name: Citizen Crystal 7
description: Vintage-inspired automatic watch from Citizen's heritage line.
longDescription: The Citizen Crystal 7 (Ref. 4-520221Y) is a classic 1960s automatic timepiece known for its reliable mechanical movement and distinctive day-date display. As one of Citizen's early automatic models, it represents the brand's vintage innovation and timeless styling.

name: Seiko SRPH87
description: Sporty Seiko 5 with bold dial and modern styling.
longDescription: The Seiko SRPH87 offers a contemporary design with strong legibility and reliable automatic performance. It’s built for daily use with solid water resistance and a comfortable bracelet.

name: Casio F-91W
description: Iconic digital watch loved worldwide for simplicity and reliability.
longDescription: The Casio F-91W is a legendary digital watch that’s been a favorite for decades. Lightweight and durable, it features a stopwatch, alarm, and LED backlight. Its minimalistic design makes it perfect for everyday use while maintaining classic charm.

name: Casio Illuminator AE-1500WH
description: Multi-function digital watch with rugged styling.
longDescription: The AE-1500WH has a large, easy-to-read display and multiple functions including world time, stopwatch, countdown timer, and daily alarms. Its oversized case gives it a bold presence.

name: Casio Pro Trek PRG-270-1
description: Outdoor-focused digital watch with sensors.
longDescription: The Casio Pro Trek PRG-270 is made for adventurers. Features include triple sensors (altimeter, barometer, compass), 200m water resistance, solar power, and a durable construction suitable for extreme conditions.

name: Casio Edifice Chronograph EFV-100D
description: Sporty analog chronograph with metal case.
longDescription: Casio Edifice chronographs combine precision with a sporty design. Features include stopwatch functionality, multiple subdials, and stainless-steel case and bracelet for a premium look and durability.

name: Casio MQ24 Classic Quartz
description: Simple and lightweight quartz analog watch.
longDescription: The Casio MQ24 is a minimalist, ultra-lightweight watch. Perfect for everyday use with a clean analog display and resin strap for comfort and durability.

name: Casio Duro MDV106-1AV
description: Affordable dive watch with professional features.
longDescription: The Casio Duro MDV-106 combines a stainless steel case, 200m water resistance, and screw-down crown to deliver a robust, affordable dive watch that’s suitable for both work and play.

name: Casio G-Shock G-5600
description: Compact square G-Shock with durable construction.
longDescription: The Casio G-Shock G5600 is a square-faced digital watch designed for toughness and reliability. Offers stopwatch, alarm, and backlight, making it a favorite among G-Shock collectors.

name: Casio G-Shock GW-9400 Rangeman
description: Rugged G-Shock built for extreme conditions.
longDescription: The Casio GW-9400 Rangeman is part of the Master of G series. Equipped with triple sensors (altimeter, barometer, compass), solar power, and 200m water resistance, it’s built for outdoor adventurers.

name: Seiko 5 SRPD51 Automatic
description: Popular Seiko 5 Sports automatic with dive-style bezel.
longDescription: The Seiko SRPD51 is one of the most popular Seiko 5 Sports models, inspired by classic dive watches. It features a reliable automatic movement and a comfortable bracelet suitable for daily wear.

name: Seiko 5 Sports SRPD63
description: Stealthy Seiko 5 Sports with blacked-out finish.
longDescription: The Seiko SRPD63 features an all-black aesthetic with a rugged, modern feel. Built with Seiko’s dependable automatic movement, it’s perfect for casual and street-style wear.

name: Seiko SNK809 Automatic
description: Iconic military-style automatic field watch.
longDescription: The Seiko SNK809 is a legendary field watch known for its compact size, legibility, and reliability. Its simple military-inspired design makes it a favorite among watch enthusiasts.

name: Seiko Solar SNE527P1
description: Solar-powered diver-style watch with clean design.
longDescription: The Seiko SNE527P1 uses Seiko’s solar technology for hassle-free operation. It offers excellent water resistance and a classic diver look without the need for battery changes.

name: Seiko Prospex Diver SRPD55
description: Prospex automatic with professional dive styling.
longDescription: The Seiko Prospex SRPD55 delivers rugged dive-watch aesthetics with reliable automatic performance. Designed for sport and daily wear, it balances toughness and comfort.

name: Seiko Turtle SRPE93
description: Classic Seiko Turtle professional dive watch.
longDescription: The Seiko Turtle SRPE93 is a modern reissue of a legendary dive watch. Its cushion case, excellent lume, and reliable automatic movement make it a true tool watch.

name: Seiko Presage Cocktail Time
description: Elegant automatic dress watch with textured dial.
longDescription: The Seiko Presage Cocktail Time blends traditional Japanese craftsmanship with modern watchmaking. Its stunning dial and smooth automatic movement make it ideal for formal wear.

name: Seiko Coutura Solar
description: Futuristic solar-powered chronograph.
longDescription: The Seiko Coutura Solar features bold lines and advanced solar technology. Designed for precision and style, it’s a modern watch with zero battery maintenance.

name: Seiko 5 GMT SSK001
description: Automatic GMT watch for travelers.
longDescription: The Seiko 5 GMT SSK001 adds true GMT functionality to the Seiko 5 lineup. Ideal for travelers, it allows tracking of multiple time zones with ease.

name: Seiko Field Watch SRPG31
description: Modern field watch with military inspiration.
longDescription: The Seiko SRPG31 is a contemporary field watch built for durability and legibility. Its simple design and automatic movement make it perfect for everyday use.

name: Citizen Promaster Dive BN0150-28E
description: Iconic Promaster ISO dive watch with black dial.
longDescription: The Citizen BN0150-28E is one of the most respected affordable dive watches available. ISO-certified for diving, it features a screw-down crown, strong lume, and a durable polyurethane strap. Eco-Drive technology ensures dependable solar-powered performance.

name: Citizen Eco-Drive Blue Angels
gallery: photos/watches/Citizen/citizen eco drive blue angels 2 jpg.jpg
description: Limited edition chronograph inspired by the Blue Angels team.
longDescription: The Citizen Eco-Drive Blue Angels watch celebrates the elite US Navy flight team with a bold blue and yellow design. Its chronograph, tachymeter, and solar-powered Eco-Drive movement make it stylish and functional for aviation enthusiasts.

name: Citizen Brycen Chronograph CA0649-06X
description: Bold chronograph with military-inspired green dial.
longDescription: The Citizen Brycen CA0649-06X offers a rugged sporty look with a deep green dial and chronograph functionality. Powered by Eco-Drive solar technology, it delivers precise timing without battery changes and is built for everyday durability.

name: Citizen Corso Eco-Drive
description: Elegant everyday watch with refined design.
longDescription: The Citizen Corso Eco-Drive BM7100-59E is a versatile dress watch with a clean black dial and polished stainless steel bracelet. Slim and comfortable, it transitions seamlessly from office wear to formal occasions while being powered by light.

name: Citizen Chandler Eco-Drive
description: Rugged casual watch with field-inspired design.
longDescription: The Citizen Chandler BM8475-00F combines military field styling with Eco-Drive solar power. Featuring a black dial, luminous markers, and a durable nylon strap, it is built for reliability and everyday toughness.

name: Citizen Titanium Eco-Drive
description: Lightweight titanium watch with solar technology.
longDescription: The Citizen BM7431-51L is crafted from Super Titanium, offering exceptional lightness and durability. Its blue dial and sleek design make it suitable for both casual and formal wear, while Eco-Drive ensures maintenance-free operation.

name: Citizen Navihawk A-T
description: Atomic timekeeping pilot-style watch with multiple time zones.
longDescription: The Citizen Navihawk A-T is a feature-packed aviation watch with atomic clock synchronization for ultimate accuracy. It has world time for 43 cities, a perpetual calendar, and a slide rule bezel, making it perfect for pilots or frequent travelers.

name: Citizen Classic Addysen Eco-Drive
description: Clean, minimalist dress watch with solar movement.
longDescription: The Citizen Addysen AW0050-82E features a simple black dial, slim profile, and stainless steel bracelet. Designed for understated elegance, it runs on Eco-Drive technology, eliminating the need for battery replacements.

name: Orient Kamasu RA-AA0004E19B
description: Classic Orient Kamasu automatic dive watch with green dial.
longDescription: The Orient Kamasu RA-AA0004E19B is a highly respected automatic diver featuring a rich green sunburst dial, sapphire crystal, and the in-house F6922 movement. With 200m water resistance and strong lume, it is built for both underwater performance and daily wear.

name: Orient Kamasu RA-AA0003R19B
description: Orient Kamasu automatic diver with bold red dial.
longDescription: The RA-AA0003R19B offers the same proven Kamasu platform but with a striking red dial. Featuring sapphire crystal and the F6922 automatic movement, it combines strong dive capability with distinctive style.

name: Orient Mako II FAA02001B9
description: Reliable Orient Mako II automatic dive watch with black dial.
longDescription: The Orient Mako II FAA02001B9 is a durable automatic dive watch powered by the in-house F6922 movement. With 200m water resistance and classic dive styling, it offers exceptional value.

name: Orient Mako III RA-AA0008B19B
description: Modernized Orient Mako III with improved finishing.
longDescription: The Mako III builds upon the Mako line with upgraded finishing and reliable in-house automatic movement. It maintains 200m water resistance and practical dive features.

name: Orient Bambino RA-AC0M04Y10B
description: Elegant Orient Bambino dress watch with champagne dial.
longDescription: The Orient Bambino RA-AC0M04Y10B features a domed crystal, minimalist dial, and automatic in-house movement. It is ideal for formal and business occasions.

name: Orient Bambino RA-AC0F01B10B
description: Classic black dial Orient Bambino automatic dress watch.
longDescription: This Bambino model features a clean black dial and domed crystal, powered by the reliable F6724 automatic movement, offering timeless elegance.

name: Orient Ray II FAA02005D9
description: Orient Ray II automatic dive watch with blue dial.
longDescription: The Ray II FAA02005D9 is a solid 200m dive watch with strong lume and in-house automatic movement, offering dependable performance at an accessible price.

name: Orient TriStar RA-AB0F09L19B
description: Affordable Orient TriStar automatic with classic styling.
longDescription: The TriStar series offers dependable automatic performance with traditional styling and day-date display, ideal for everyday wear.

name: Orient Star RE-AU0004B00B
description: Premium Orient Star automatic with power reserve indicator.
longDescription: The Orient Star RE-AU0004B00B features superior finishing, a power reserve display, and in-house automatic movement, representing a higher tier of Orient craftsmanship.

name: Orient Defender RA-AK0401L10B
description: Rugged Orient Defender field-style automatic watch.
longDescription: The Defender RA-AK0401L10B combines military-inspired design with day-date display and automatic movement, making it a practical everyday tool watch.

name: Orient Open Heart RA-AG0003S10B
description: Orient open-heart automatic with elegant dial design.
longDescription: This model showcases the automatic movement through an open-heart dial, blending mechanical appeal with refined aesthetics.

name: Orient Neo 70s WV0041TX
description: Retro-inspired Orient Neo 70’s chronograph.
longDescription: The Neo 70’s WV0041TX features vintage design cues with chronograph functionality, offering a sporty yet nostalgic aesthetic.

name: Orient Sun and Moon RA-AK0008S10B
description: Elegant Orient Sun and Moon complication watch.
longDescription: Featuring a sun and moon indicator, this model combines classic dress styling with useful calendar functions and automatic movement.

name: Orient Contemporary RA-SP0002S10B
description: Modern Orient contemporary automatic with clean dial.
longDescription: A minimalist automatic watch featuring clean lines, balanced proportions, and dependable in-house mechanical movement.

name: Seiko SSA459J1
description: Sophisticated automatic dress watch with timeless design.
longDescription: The Seiko SSA459J1 is a refined automatic timepiece that blends elegant styling with dependable performance. Its clean dial, classic indices, and day-date complication make it ideal for both formal wear and everyday office use. Powered by Seiko's reliable automatic movement, it offers lasting durability and traditional mechanical watch appeal.

name: Casio AQ-800E-7A
description: A retro-inspired analog-digital watch with a slim vintage design.
longDescription: The Casio AQ-800E-7A combines classic 1980s styling with practical modern functionality. Featuring an elegant analog display paired with a small digital screen, this model delivers dual-time capability in a slim and lightweight stainless steel case. The clean white dial enhances its vintage aesthetic, while useful features like an alarm, stopwatch, and automatic calendar make it perfect for everyday wear.
